::: {.home-main}

Hi! I'm a fourth-year Ph.D. ~~student~~ candidate in Education Policy and Program Evaluation, and my field course is in the Economics of Education. I'm originally from Nicaragua, where I grew up and lived until I finished my bachelor's degree. As of today, my research is on how education can protect and rebuild children's human capital after armed conflict, forced displacement, and political crises.

I am currently co-leading a randomized controlled trial in 450 public schools in Armenia, which tests an education and psychosocial program for children displaced by the Nagorno-Karabakh conflict. I also recently co-led another RCT in Ukraine with more than 10,000 students, where we added mental health components to an online tutoring program.

I am affiliated with the [Center for International Development (CID)](https://www.hks.harvard.edu/centers/cid/about-cid/people/phd-affiliates/rony-rodrigo-maximiliano-rodriguez-ramirez) and the [Institute for Quantitative Social Science (IQSS)](https://www.iq.harvard.edu/people/rony-rodrigo-maximiliano-rodriguez-ramirez), and I co-founded the [Education Lab for Latin America (ELLA)](https://ella.gse.harvard.edu/) at the Harvard Graduate School of Education.
